discogs.title: Nevermind
discogs.notes:
Issued as a standard jewel case containing an 8-panel foldout inlay with liner notes, pics and credits

Track durations are not printed on the release
Track 12 contains a hidden track. 'Something In The Way' ends at 3:51 followed by a 10 minute silence until the unlisted track 'Endless, Nameless' starts at 13:51. Total track length is 20:35.
